note: Partial: pass 1 from search snippets and press, pass 2 from brands' own sites. Fields left null rather than guessed. Brands not listed were not researched.

mira-matcha.story: Mira Matcha is a San Antonio matcha shop that began as a once-a-week pop-up at a market. It grew into a weekend trailer and then a cafe, and is known for ceremonial-grade matcha with Latin-inspired flavors.

green-times-matcha.story: Green Times Matcha is a Honolulu matcha business run by founder Jinie Ho, who started it in July 2025 as a mobile cart for company events. It does pop-ups around Oahu and is known for fruity cold-foam matcha lattes.

ritual-grounds.story: Ritual Grounds is a playful matcha and coffee pop-up in St. Petersburg, Florida, run by Jonathan Villafane and his partner Ian. It serves single-origin Uji matcha in creative drinks.

whiskd-tea.story: whisk'd is a mobile creative collective that runs pop-up drink events around the Washington, DC area. It serves handcrafted matcha and specialty coffee at farmers markets and with local bars and community spaces.
whiskd-tea.typical_hours: Farmers markets about 9am to 1pm on Saturdays

more-than-matcha.story: More Than Matcha is a woman-owned Los Angeles brand founded by LA native Rosie Goldwasser. It uses organic ceremonial matcha from Kagoshima, Japan and is known for its cream-top Summer Cloud drinks.

nok108-matcha.story: NOK108 is a Charlottesville matcha truck run by UVA alumna Yuna Park with her mother and sister, drawing on their family's matcha business in Japan. It is known for inventive flavors and pastel de nata egg tarts.

isshiki-matcha.story: Isshiki Matcha is a New York matcha cafe in the East Village founded by Angel Zheng, who sources from a third-generation family farm in Uji, Kyoto. Its best seller is the strawberry matcha latte.

caffeine-depot.story: Caffeine Depot is a San Francisco pop-up and catering business serving handcrafted Vietnamese coffee and premium matcha, with no fixed storefront. It shows up at farmers markets and events around the Bay Area.

janes-matcha-jc.story: Jane's Matcha was founded by Jersey City Heights resident Jane Yang, who started it as a farmers market pop-up in May 2024. It now has a shop at 93 Franklin Street and is known for the Honeycomb Latte.
janes-matcha-jc.typical_hours: Shop 7am to 4pm Mon, Wed to Fri; 9am to 4pm weekends; closed Tue

the-matcha-edit.story: The Matcha Edit is a matcha and coffee pop-up inside Roots Bookstore, a Black-owned bookshop in Liberty City, Miami. It runs on an 'Edit Your Energy' idea of slowing down and sipping mindfully.
the-matcha-edit.typical_hours: Roots Bookstore is open Tue to Sat, noon to 6pm; pop-up days reported as Thu and Sat

oohmami-matcha.story: Oohmami Matcha is an Atlanta direct-to-consumer matcha brand founded by Chanel Allen, who set out to make a less processed matcha at home. She sells powder and drinks at the Grant Park Farmers Market on Sundays.
oohmami-matcha.typical_hours: Sundays at Grant Park Farmers Market

tea-loft.story: Tea Loft is a Portland matcha and tea house at 4214 N Mississippi Ave. It serves ceremonial matcha lattes, hojicha, fruit and milk teas, and pastries from a partner bakery.

central-matcha.story: Central Matcha is an Austin small business built on 100% ceremonial matcha sourced directly from Kagoshima, Japan. The founder's college barista job inspired it, and Austin cafes also buy its matcha.
central-matcha.typical_hours: Saturdays at Bell and Barton Creek farmers markets; Sundays at Mueller farmers market

cha-cha-matcha.story: Cha Cha Matcha is a New York-born matcha cafe brand co-founded by Matthew Morton and Conrad Sandelman. It opened its first Los Angeles shop on Robertson Boulevard and aims to make matcha fun and quick.

333-matcha.story: 333Matcha is a Latino-owned matcha cart that sets up on weekends at CommonRags Studio in Oak Cliff, Dallas.

mellobun-matte-matcha.story: Mellobun is a pop-up sourdough bakery near Sacramento that sells walk-up only, first come first served. It teams up with Matte Matcha Bar for matcha and hojicha lattes.

dream-tea-nyc.story: Dream Tea NYC is a woman-owned tea company that sells loose-leaf and plastic-free tea bags plus ceremonial matcha from Japan. It runs holiday market stands around New York.

daylight-matcha.story: Daylight Matcha is a Los Angeles brand inspired by Japanese tea rituals, selling premium Uji matcha and hojicha sourced from Kyoto. It also makes matcha kits with HARIO.

thelis-coffee.story: Thelis Coffee is a mobile coffee and matcha service for New Jersey and NYC events. The name comes from the founders' grandfather asking passing motorcyclists "Thelis cup?" in the Greek mountains.

big-wiss-matcha.story: Big Wiss Matcha is Wiss's own matcha cart in Dearborn, Michigan, serving handcrafted matcha at weekend pop-ups, restaurant nights and private events. It is known for a new dessert flavor at every pop-up and a red heart on every lid.

vale-matcha.story: Vale Matcha is a Seattle matcha brand, "Seattle's Matcha on Tap", with a cafe at 2000 Terry Ave. It is planting its own tea farm, Vale Farms, on Whidbey Island.
